units.source_text: 老人小声地应了一声，眼里噙着泪珠。

en.t: The old man answered softly, tears brimming in his eyes.

units.source_text: 他着实难为情地垂下了头。

en.t: He lowered his head in genuine embarrassment.

units.source_text: 忽然有一种感情渗透到我的全身，这种一味气盛的强烈兴奋，获得了反省式的宁静。

en.t: Suddenly a feeling seeped through my whole body, and that fierce excitement born purely of high spirits settled into a reflective calm.

units.source_text: “把女儿交给我吧”这样一种几乎是带有强迫性的心情受到了挫折，我感到有点伤心。

en.t: The almost coercive feeling of wanting to say, "Entrust your daughter to me," was thwarted, and I felt a little sad.
